Method of Attack: Encrypts files on the compromised machine and demands ransom for file decryption
Attack Vector: Execution on a victim’s system, files encrypted and changed to have a '.darky' file extension
Indicators of Compromise: 0.005BTC (approximately $120.00USD) demanded as ransom, Bitcoin wallet mentioned but no transactions observed

Method of Attack: Encrypts files on compromised machines and adds a file extension named after the target company to the affected files
Attack Vector: MSI (Windows installer) file delivered to the target machine containing a Windows DLL file that requires specific criteria to execute
Indicators of Compromise: MSI installer and Windows DLL file, unique installation criteria for each victim organization

Method of Attack: Encrypts files on a victim’s machine, demands a price of $980USD to have software provided to decrypt the affected files, offers a discount for payment within the first 72 hours
Attack Vector: STOP/DJVU ransomware variant executed on a victim’s machine, files encrypted with a '.vvyu' file extension
Indicators of Compromise: $980USD demanded as ransom, support e-mail addresses and a unique ID provided for contact with operators

Method of Attack: Encrypts files of interest on a victim machine and demands a ransom of $300USD worth of Bitcoin (0.012BTC) to be sent to a wallet controlled by the malware authors
Attack Vector: Ransom note and screen similar to WannaCry, no self-propagation mechanism, files encrypted with a '.Kriptor' file extension
Indicators of Compromise: $300USD worth of Bitcoin (0.012BTC) demanded as ransom, no transactions observed using the Bitcoin wallet mentioned in the ransom note

Method of Attack: Uses the 'double extortion' method, encrypts files and threatens to release a victim’s data on the Internet if they do not pay the requested ransom
Attack Vector: Ransom note deposited in any directory where files have been encrypted, files encrypted with a '.cuba' file extension
Indicators of Compromise: Unique ID to contact ransomware controllers via Tox or backup e-mail address
